budget_note: Same trial budget and one seed for both arms. Do not spawn X50R-L / X50R-nested variants.
unique_slot_rule: Score only unique (task_type, dataset, algorithm) slots. find_traj must filter traj CSVs by the majority 'algorithm' column; do not pick the best best_so_far across algorithms on the same dataset.

decision_rule.primary: Mean rank of each variant across unique slots where BOTH X50 and X50R have a complete 80-trial traj. Lower mean rank wins.
decision_rule.secondary: Head-to-head on those same unique slots: count slots where X50R final best_so_far > X50 (higher-is-better scores, rgs already negated).
decision_rule.keep_X50_if: tie on mean rank, or X50R loses mean rank, or h2h_wins <= h2h_losses
